試試看

segments.en: One request at a time per connection. Browsers open about 6 connections per site and queue the rest.
segments.zh: 每條連線一次只能處理一個請求。瀏覽器對每個網站大約開 6 條連線，其他的都要排隊。

segments.en: One TCP connection, many requests at once (multiplexing), compressed headers. But TCP still delivers bytes in order, so one lost packet stalls every request.
segments.zh: 一條 TCP 連線同時處理很多請求（多工，multiplexing），並壓縮標頭。但 TCP 仍然依序傳遞位元組，所以遺失一個封包就會卡住所有請求。

segments.en: HTTP over QUIC, which runs on UDP. Streams are independent, so a loss only delays its own stream, and the connection and encryption are set up in one round trip.
segments.zh: 跑在 QUIC 上的 HTTP，而 QUIC 跑在 UDP 上。各個串流彼此獨立，所以遺失只會延遲它自己的串流，而且連線和加密在一次來回內就建立好。
關鍵差別

segments.en: HTTP/2 removed the queue: many requests share one connection instead of waiting for a free one. HTTP/3 removed what was left in the way: TCP's in-order delivery (head-of-line blocking, page 22) and the extra round trips of separate TCP and TLS handshakes.
segments.zh: HTTP/2 拿掉了佇列：很多請求共用一條連線，而不是等待空閒的連線。HTTP/3 則拿掉了剩下的障礙：TCP 的依序傳遞（隊頭阻塞，見第 22 頁），以及分開進行 TCP 和 TLS 交握所多花的來回。

segments.zh: 整頁濃縮在一個畫面
同時處理很多個
多工

segments.en: HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 send many requests over one connection. No more queueing, no more 6-connection limit.
segments.zh: HTTP/2 和 HTTP/3 在一條連線上傳送很多請求。不再排隊，也不再有 6 條連線的限制。
彼此獨立
QUIC 串流

segments.en: HTTP/3's streams don't block each other on loss. Biggest win on lossy mobile networks.
segments.zh: HTTP/3 的串流不會因為遺失而互相阻塞。在會掉封包的行動網路上效益最大。
更快開始
更少的來回

segments.en: QUIC combines connecting and encrypting into one round trip (zero when resuming). Matters most when the server is far away.
segments.zh: QUIC 把連線和加密合併成一次來回（恢復連線時甚至是零次）。伺服器越遠，差別越大。
取捨

segments.en: Upgrading is mostly free speed, enabled in your CDN or web server. Costs: some networks block UDP (browsers fall back to HTTP/2), QUIC uses more CPU than TCP today, and debugging tools are younger. Tricks from the HTTP/1 era (bundling everything, domain sharding) matter much less now.
segments.zh: 升級大致上是免費的速度，在 CDN 或網頁伺服器上開啟即可。代價：有些網路會擋 UDP（瀏覽器會退回 HTTP/2）、QUIC 目前比 TCP 更耗 CPU，除錯工具也比較新。HTTP/1 時代的技巧（全部打包成一包、網域分散）現在重要性低很多。

segments.en: `⚠ HTTP/1.1: only 6 requests can be in flight; the other ${FILES.length - 7} wait in queues (yellow). Each new connection also pays its own handshakes.`
segments.zh: `⚠ HTTP/1.1：同時只能有 6 個請求在進行；其他 ${FILES.length - 7} 個在佇列中等待（黃色）。每條新連線也要付出自己的交握成本。`

segments.en: `✕ HTTP/2 on a lossy network: one lost TCP packet stalled ${stalled} files at once (red), because TCP must deliver every byte in order before any stream can continue.`
segments.zh: `✕ 在會掉封包的網路上使用 HTTP/2：一個遺失的 TCP 封包同時卡住了 ${stalled} 個檔案（紅色），因為 TCP 必須依序送完每個位元組，任何串流才能繼續。`

segments.en: '✓ HTTP/2: every file is requested at once over a single connection. No queues.'
segments.zh: '✓ HTTP/2：所有檔案都在同一條連線上同時被請求。沒有佇列。'

segments.en: `✓ HTTP/3: the same lost packet only stalled ${stalled} file; the other streams kept going. And QUIC needed one round trip fewer to connect.`
segments.zh: `✓ HTTP/3：同樣遺失的封包只卡住了 ${stalled} 個檔案；其他串流照常進行。而且 QUIC 少一次來回就連上了。`

segments.en: '✓ HTTP/3: multiplexed like HTTP/2, and connected one round trip sooner.'
segments.zh: '✓ HTTP/3：跟 HTTP/2 一樣多工，而且早一次來回就連上了。'
'無遺失'
'會掉封包（遺失一個封包）'
'用 HTTP/1.1 載入頁面。'

segments.en: 'See the yellow queues: only six files can be in flight at a time.'
segments.zh: '看看黃色的佇列：同時只能有六個檔案在傳輸。'
'切換到 HTTP/2，再載入一次。'

segments.en: 'Everything is requested at once on a single connection. Compare the times in the list.'
segments.zh: '所有東西都在一條連線上同時被請求。比較列表中的時間。'

segments.en: 'Keep HTTP/2, set the network to Lossy, and load.'
segments.zh: '維持 HTTP/2，把網路設成會掉封包，然後載入。'

segments.en: 'One lost packet. Count the red bars.'
segments.zh: '遺失一個封包。數數看有幾條紅色長條。'

segments.en: 'Now try HTTP/3 on the same lossy network.'
segments.zh: '現在在同樣會掉封包的網路上試試 HTTP/3。'

segments.en: 'Same lost packet. How many files does it stall now?'
segments.zh: '同樣遺失一個封包。現在它卡住了幾個檔案？'
'檢查 HTTP/2'

segments.en: 'Ask for HTTP/2 explicitly and print the status line. Browser devtools show the same thing in the Network tab\'s “Protocol” column.'
segments.zh: '明確要求 HTTP/2 並印出狀態列。瀏覽器開發者工具的 Network 分頁中「Protocol」欄位也會顯示同樣的資訊。'
'檢查 HTTP/3'

segments.en: 'Needs a curl built with HTTP/3 support. If it falls back, the server or the network doesn\'t offer QUIC.'
segments.zh: '需要支援 HTTP/3 的 curl 版本。如果它退回舊協定，代表伺服器或網路沒有提供 QUIC。'
'TCP 監聽'

segments.en: 'HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 both run over TCP + TLS on port 443.'
segments.zh: 'HTTP/1.1 和 HTTP/2 都跑在 443 埠的 TCP＋TLS 上。'

segments.en: 'One line. Browsers only use HTTP/2 over HTTPS, and negotiate it during the TLS handshake.'
segments.zh: '只要一行。瀏覽器只會在 HTTPS 上使用 HTTP/2，並在 TLS 交握時協商。'
'QUIC 監聽'

segments.en: 'HTTP/3 runs on QUIC over UDP, on the same port number. This is the lab\'s “HTTP/3”.'
segments.zh: 'HTTP/3 跑在 UDP 上的 QUIC，使用相同的埠號。這就是實驗室的「HTTP/3」。'

segments.en: 'Browsers connect with TCP first. This header tells them “HTTP/3 is available here”, so the next connections can use QUIC.'
segments.zh: '瀏覽器會先用 TCP 連線。這個標頭告訴它們「這裡有 HTTP/3」，之後的連線就能使用 QUIC。'

segments.en: 'Encore switches its CDN from HTTP/1.1 to HTTP/2. Which old optimization matters much less now?'
segments.zh: 'Encore 把 CDN 從 HTTP/1.1 換成 HTTP/2。哪一種舊的最佳化現在重要性低很多？'
'壓縮圖片'

segments.en: 'Still important: smaller files are faster with any protocol.'
segments.zh: '仍然很重要：不管哪種協定，檔案越小越快。'

segments.en: 'Splitting files across several domains so browsers open more connections'
segments.zh: '把檔案分散到好幾個網域，讓瀏覽器開更多連線'

segments.en: 'That trick worked around HTTP/1.1\'s per-connection queueing. HTTP/2 multiplexes on one connection, so the extra connections just cost handshakes.'
segments.zh: '這個技巧是用來繞過 HTTP/1.1 每條連線要排隊的問題。HTTP/2 在一條連線上多工，額外的連線只會多花交握成本。'
'使用 CDN'

segments.en: 'Being close to fans still saves round trips on every protocol.'
segments.zh: '離歌迷近一點，不管哪種協定都能省下來回時間。'

segments.en: 'Why does HTTP/3 help most on bad mobile networks?'
segments.zh: '為什麼 HTTP/3 在很差的行動網路上幫助最大？'
'它壓縮得更用力'

segments.en: 'Header compression is similar. The difference is how loss is handled.'
segments.zh: '標頭壓縮差不多。差別在於怎麼處理遺失。'

segments.en: 'A lost packet only delays its own stream instead of every stream on the connection'
segments.zh: '遺失的封包只會延遲它自己的串流，而不是連線上的每一個串流'

segments.en: 'HTTP/2 over TCP suffers head-of-line blocking; QUIC streams are independent. It also reconnects faster when a phone switches networks.'
segments.zh: '走 TCP 的 HTTP/2 會受隊頭阻塞所苦；QUIC 的串流彼此獨立。手機切換網路時，它重新連線也更快。'
'它更有效率地使用 TCP'

segments.en: 'HTTP/3 doesn\'t use TCP at all: it runs on QUIC over UDP.'
segments.zh: 'HTTP/3 完全不用 TCP：它跑在 UDP 上的 QUIC。'

segments.en: 'Cai enables HTTP/3, but a few fans\' office networks block UDP. What happens for them?'
segments.zh: 'Cai 開啟了 HTTP/3，但有幾位歌迷的公司網路會擋 UDP。他們會怎樣？'
'網站對他們來說會壞掉'
'瀏覽器會優雅地處理這種情況。'

segments.en: 'Their browsers keep using HTTP/2 over TCP, as before'
segments.zh: '他們的瀏覽器會照舊繼續使用 TCP 上的 HTTP/2'

segments.en: 'HTTP/3 is advertised (Alt-Svc) and tried; if QUIC can\'t get through, the browser falls back.'
segments.zh: 'HTTP/3 會被宣告（Alt-Svc）並嘗試使用；如果 QUIC 過不去，瀏覽器就會退回去。'
'他們會拿到 HTTP/1.0'

segments.en: 'They fall back to HTTP/2, not to a much older version.'
segments.zh: '他們會退回 HTTP/2，而不是古老得多的版本。'
